name: Kurashina Asuka
source:
"I don't think you'll find anyone with interests as straightforward as me."

An all-natural girl who prefers to fly in straight-on. Always speaks politely, no matter who she's talking to. A very well-mannered transfer student. Diligent and brimming with curiosity, once she sets her mind to a goal, she'll always give it her all to achieve it.

Favorite Food: Strawberries
Hobbies: Walking her dog
Residence: New residential area
Family: Father (researcher at a company - natural gas, methane, geologist, etc.), Mother, Pet dog

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/asuka-kurashina/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
